name: com.hoverlabs.rigby2d
description: Runtime for Rigby2D 2D skeletal animation: drop in skeleton exports (.json / .skel + .atlas) or scenes exported from the Rigby2D editor and play them. Matches the Rigby2D editor frame by frame: meshes, weights, IK, transform, path, physics and slider constraints, skins, sequences, clipping, events, crossfades and layered tracks.
